subtitle: Out Manila · Air Changan (charter)
overview: A charter flight takes you from Manila to Yichang, then by coach to Furong Town and Zhangjiajie for the Avatar scenic area (Bailong Lift, No. 1 Bridge, Avatar Hallelujah Mountain) and Tusi City. On the last day, enjoy the Yangtze River Three Gorges Tribe scenic area with a cruise before flying home.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 6–10 2026 to Dec 23–27 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient Tujia town built beside a waterfall in Hunan, lit up beautifully at night.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-bottomed bridge over a deep gorge near Zhangjiajie; optional tour at USD 70 per person.
placeDesc.Tusi City: A recreated Tujia chieftain city near Zhangjiajie showing the culture of the Tujia people.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A famous Zhangjiajie mountain with cable car, glass skywalk and Tianmen Cave; optional tour USD 85 per person.
placeDesc.Avatar scenic area: The sandstone-pillar landscape of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, associated with the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A glass outdoor elevator built into a cliff face, used on this tour to go up or down the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge feature in the Zhangjiajie Avatar scenic area, visited on the walk.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The floating-mountain-style sandstone peak in Zhangjiajie that inspired scenes in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.West Sea Clouds: A scenic viewpoint in the Avatar scenic area, visited along the walking route.
placeDesc.Baofeng Lake: A scenic lake near Zhangjiajie; the optional tour includes a boat cruise.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Tribe: A scenic area on the Yangtze River near Yichang; the tour includes a cruise here.
placeDesc.Qu Yuan’s Hometown: The birthplace area of the ancient poet Qu Yuan, near Yichang.
placeDesc.San You Cave: A scenic limestone cave and gorge area near Yichang on the Yangtze.
